h: Shabbos Gives Yisrael the Power of the Divine Word

p: In the Pesikta on this haftarah (section 4; Pesikta Rabbasi 27:1):
behold, you have nullified all the commandments;
even one thing, had you kept it,
שֶׁכֵּן הוּא אוֹמֵר לְיִרְמְיָה (יִרְמְיָה יז, כב)
for so He says to Yirmiyahu (Yirmiyahu 17:22):
'Do not carry a burden out of your houses
on the day of Shabbos,' etc.;
וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ אֵלַי (שָׁם יז, כז)
'and if you do not listen to Me (Yirmiyahu 17:27)
to sanctify the day of Shabbos'
for the land will become a ruin.
'Hear the word of Hashem, House of Yaakov';
'from pursuing your affairs and speaking a word';
'And you, speak to the Children of Israel.'"
from what is written, "and speaking a word":
so how does it bring from it a proof
that what is said, "the word of Hashem,"
that your speech on Shabbos should not be
such as business dealings and accounts;
it refers to a person's speech;
that "the word of Hashem" is Shabbos?
Also, as for its bringing proof
"And you, speak to the Children of Israel,"
which is said in Parshas Ki Sisa
it expounds from what is written,
וְזֶהוּ רַק עַל יְדֵי מִצְוַת שַׁבָּת
and that is only through the mitzvah of Shabbos,
"Who keeps the Shabbos from desecrating it,"
even if he worshipped idols like the generation of Enosh,
And the Pesikta brings from Yirmiyahu,
"And it shall be, if you diligently listen," etc.,
"and to sanctify the day of Shabbos," etc.,
"then there shall enter by the gates of the city
by the gates of this city
and there will be the Geulah;
"but if you do not listen," etc.,
"then I will kindle a fire," etc.;
that is, everything depends on Shabbos.
two Shabbosos as they should be kept,
(as they said in the Gemara there, Shabbos 118b);
that is, the main thing is
and for this the preparation is
to merit on the second Shabbos
And if they merited, on one Shabbos,
then they would immediately be redeemed.
And this is what they said
(Yerushalmi, Zohar Chadash and many other places),
שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר ה׳ בֵּית יַעֲקֹב וְגוֹ׳
'Hear the word of Hashem, House of Yaakov,'" etc.,
and you will be redeemed immediately.
as it says, 'from pursuing your affairs
and it relies on the end of the passage,
"for the mouth of Hashem has spoken."
"If you restrain your foot because of Shabbos," etc.,
be in the aspect of "the mouth of Hashem."
what is written in Sefer Yetzirah:
and the mouth in the soul";
לֹא קָאֵי עַל אֵבֶר הַפֶּה כִּפְשׁוּטוֹ
it does not refer literally to the organ of the mouth,
that it was created on Shabbos,
and gave names to all the creatures.
that then, on Shabbos, a mouth in the soul was created;
that is, a person will speak,
in the aspect of "the mouth of Hashem has spoken."
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רא, ב)
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar (III 201b):
And this is what is said: "ve'daber davar,"
and it does not say "u'midaber davar"
and according to the explanation of Rashi and Tosafos
that he not speak of mundane matters
But the meaning of "ve'daber davar" is
that it be as they said (Shabbos 138b):
"'The word of Hashem' — this is halachah."
And this is as it says
we call it Torah she'b'al peh.
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם לב, א)
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar (there, I 32a):
"And this speech is called Shabbos," etc.

p: 'And you, speak to the Children of Israel'";
and the intent is not from the word "speak,"
"But My Shabbosos you shall keep," etc.;
וְאַתָּה דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמוֹר
"And you, speak to the Children of Israel, lemor,"
which means to say to Yisrael.
But My Shabbosos you shall keep";
"That you may know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you":
is that he should instill in them the aspect of Da'as,
and recognize "that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you."
And that is the good gift,
For this is the power of Moshe:
that is, that it be the word of Hashem,
the aspect of the Mouth of Hashem;
the level of all the prophets
was the aspect of "Thus said Hashem,"
relating what he heard from Hashem Yisbarach;
which is not so with "zeh hadavar,"
is the word that Hashem spoke,
for at the time of his speaking
the Shechinah speaks from within his throat.
And this is what is said:
"And you, speak to the Children of Israel"
he will instill this power in Yisrael,
and it be in the aspect of the Mouth of Hashem.
And this is what we say:
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion"
on which the mouth in the soul was created,
that there be power in his speech
that it be in the aspect of "the mouth of Hashem has spoken,"
And it is written "ve'atah" with a vav,
which is called "the letter of truth";
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And along the lines of what is written in the holy Zohar
to include the Shechinah with him;
the upper light and the lower light
(Bereishis Rabbah, parsha 51, and Yerushalmi, perek Chelek):
it means He and His court";
that is, the Name Adnus: alef-dalet with "dina"
"the law of the kingdom is law."
who was a chariot for the Name Havayah;
and this is what it says,
And to instill this power in Yisrael
and there must be the union
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah,
כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה גַּם לָהֶם כֹּחַ זֶה
so that they too have this power,
and it will be "the mouth of Hashem has spoken."
And this is what is said:
"Hear the word of Hashem, House of Yaakov"
And through the mitzvah of Shabbos,
and through this they are immediately redeemed.
